questiontext.text:
Which of the following is NOT a major Problem experienced in the Measurement of Fertility

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is It is an assumption that some women are not fertile.

Fertility assumes that all women of \(15-49\) years are fertile and are giving birth..

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is It is assumed that fertility is a deterministic event, in that, every woman between the ages \(15-49\) years is not birth.

Fertility is assumed to be a random event in that every woman between ages \(15-49\) is giving birth.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

The correct answer is There is an assumption that a woman can give birth to twins at any given time .

Fertility assume that no woman can have multiple births .

[[/ if ]]
